name: open-design
purpose: Refine an actual rendered interface while preserving product truth, accessibility and explicit provider choice.

criteria.description: Preserve the product brief, identity, constraints and truthful content.
Inspect actual renders at relevant sizes/states; missing captures remain unreviewed.
Reuse semantic tokens/components and preserve accessibility.
Use an explicitly selected provider and report its actual runtime limits.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
Actual provider/runtime access is required for execution. Verification does not start a provider job, proxy or account session.
The deterministic core does not render a UI or authenticate visual quality; use actual available rendering/provider tools and inspect the real states.
